build.sources: gitCommit plus the changes of the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from that working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_golden_room.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: Gate D golden of the arcade room (I6 step 6, ADR-0014 §6, style 5.4 and 14.4, concept panel 5): the esde/building fixture's arcade room under its pink ARCADE neon, mame's 15 invented titles as the screens of pairs of generic upright cabinets (arcade_cabinet: lit marquees in generic words, magenta and cyan mouldings, portrait screens through a picture tube), the six featured in the two pairs facing the aisle and the pair beside the hero corner, the rest along the walls, the empty cabinets' screens asking for a coin; the hero cabinet carrying the room's clip held at 1.0 s where the TV stood, red bar stools by its side, the dark red runner, a floor lamp, flyers and plants; from the doorway (the room's doorway camera).

image.format: PNG, 8-bit RGB, sRGB-encoded as the window shows it
